newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 24.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 24.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising,
Marketing, Media, the Internet and Brand-name Products.
ADVERTISING & MARKETING:
CANNES - Havas Advertising's turnover is growing faster than
earlier forecast, says Vice Chairman Jean-Michel Carlo.
(Reuter)
CANNES - The two giants of French advertising, Havas Advertising
and Publicis, are voicing contrasting views on the outlook for
advertising in France following the recent French parliamentary
elections. (Reuter)
MEDIA & THE INTERNET
PARIS - French pay television firm Canal Plus declines to
comment on news reports that it's on the point of selling its
37.5-percent stake in German pay television channel Premiere to
Bavarian media moghul Leo Kirch. (Reuter)
PARIS - Fun TV, which arrived on digital television service TPS
recently, gets favourable subscriber indications from a poll it
commissioned from BVA less than six months after its launch. (Le
Figaro)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:
PARIS - French anti-tobacco activists hail a landmark accord
between U.S. authorities and cigarette companies, but the
tobacco industry and financial analysts say such a settlement is
unlikely in France. (Reuter)
GENEVA - Europe and the United States disagree on milk
processing standards at a commission of the World Health
Organisation in Geneva. The U.S. wants to enforce
pasteurisation, which would cut off markets for cheeses made in
France, Italy and Switzerland from unpasteurised milk, a market
with annual turnover of 42 billion francs ($7.2 billion). (Les
Echos)
Paris Editorial, Sue Landau
